message.content: In one of EmilyBurnett's conversations with LiHua, EmilyBurnett expresses that she has not encountered anyone quite as unique and extraordinary as Sheldon Cooper in real life. She mentions, "I've met some really smart folks, but none with that level of... shall we say, eccentricity?" This indicates that EmilyBurnett has not personally met someone who matches the characteristics of Sheldon Cooper as portrayed in the TV show "The Big Bang Theory."
